wrong_claims: Section 6: 'No profile has an explicit grant on the field; users with View All Data still see it.' View All Data does not override field-level security; with no profile FieldPermissions rows, users who rely only on their profile (including admins without one of the 4 permission sets) cannot see Lead_Conversion_Probability__c at all.

defects.defect: Wrong platform claim that View All Data lets users see a field without FLS grants.
defects.skill_gap: None explicit: SKILL.md/org-verification do not state that View All Data / Modify All Data never bypass FLS.

defects.defect: Visibility gap missed: FieldPermissions shows only 4 permission sets (no profiles) grant Read on the output field, so sales users viewing Lead Layout will not see the score; the spec says existing readers 'see' it and adds no FLS change or open decision.
defects.skill_gap: None explicit: no instruction to check that the intended audience actually has FLS on an output field that is being repurposed.

defects.defect: The single inventory row converts an existing Number(18,2) custom field in place to a Formula field. Salesforce does not generally allow changing an existing non-formula custom field to the Formula type (Change Field Type offers no Formula option); feasibility is presented as fact, not labelled as an assumption, and no fallback (new formula field, or before-save flow writing the existing field) is given.
defects.skill_gap: Rule 3 (label undocumented/unverified platform behavior as assumption) would have caught it if applied; no specific rule about field-type conversion limits.
